goals.title: Generate verified RIO commercial revenue
goals.objective: Generate verified real affiliate commercial revenue through RIO as soon as practically possible, with Victor free to research, strategize, route, experiment, learn, and replan continuously.
success_conditions: A genuine external affiliate purchase or equivalent commission-generating conversion is recorded by the relevant platform.
The resulting commission or commercial outcome is traceable to evidence and is not inferred from internal activity alone.
Victor records the verified outcome and the strategy that produced it into durable operational memory.
